risks.title: Impact of Tariffs on Costs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of Item 1A and related to a goodwill impairment of 1,021.9 M$ in 2025. The language is alarming (material adverse impact). This is a new major risk compared to 2024, amplified by uncertainty following the Supreme Court decision. High weighting for macro risks.

risks.title: Massive Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: A goodwill impairment of 1,021.9 M$ is reported in the Consumer Products segment, mentioned in operating results. The language is definitive (non-cash charge). This reflects severe deterioration in forward prospects. Capital category highly sensitive.

risks.title: Dependence on Third-Party IP Licenses
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in the sharp increase in royalties related to Universes Beyond (Marvel, Final Fantasy). The text emphasizes the payment obligation. Less central than in 2024 but heightened intensity. Competition category weighted medium.

risks.title: Revenue Concentration on Magic
risks.score_rationale: Magic: The Gathering experienced record performance in 2025. The text mentions offsetting declines for other brands. Risk of strategic imbalance. Industry category medium weighted.

risks.title: Reduction in Film Releases and Entertainment Content
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions reduced slate of entertainment releases impacting entertainment-related franchises. Mentioned in results but less critical than in 2024. Industry category.

risks.title: Currency and Cash Flow Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is potentially present in Other (income) expense, net. Measured impact in 2025 but not central. Credit category less critical. Neutral language.

risks.title: Repositioning of Reinvent Brands
risks.score_rationale: Brands undergoing reinvention (NERF, MY LITTLE PONY) are struggling to recover. Structural risk on relaunching legacy brands. Industry category.
